{{Current events|year=2019|month=08|day=9|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->

;Business and economy.
*The [[U.S. Environmental Protection Agency]] has given waivers to 31 small oil refineries, freeing them from obligations to blend biofuels into their gasoline. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-ethanol-epa/trumps-epa-grants-31-small-refinery-waivers-from-biofuel-laws-angering-corn-lobby-idUSKCN1UZ2AV?il=0 (Reuters)]
*The [[International Monetary Fund]] finds that China's currency, the [[Yuan (currency)|yuan]], has been "broadly stable" against other currencies over the last year. The yuan is pulled down by market pressures due to the slowing economy. Suggesting little intervention by [[People’s Bank of China|China's central bank]], the IMF position is at odds with the designation of China by the U.S. as a [[currency manipulator]]. [https://apnews.com/acaaa89d6ff84499977480f3145c91c1 (AP News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*A landslide in south-eastern [[Myanmar]] kills 59 people. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-49329280 (BBC)]

*A massive power failure affects most of the northwestern and southeastern [[United Kingdom]] and [[London]], leaving thousands of homes, various [[Rail transport in Great Britain|train lines]], and parts of [[Newcastle International Airport]] without power. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-powercut/major-power-cut-impacting-homes-transport-in-large-parts-of-britain-idUSKCN1UZ20J (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Canadians|Canadian]] tourist Kristian Lee Baxter, who had been held in [[Syria]]n detention since 2018, is released in [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-49291172 (BBC)]  
*''[[Le Parisien]]'' claims [[France|French]] ex-head of security {{ill|Yves Bonnet|fr}} brokered a secret deal with [[Fatah]] in the 1980s offering immunity in exchange for no further [[terrorism in France|terror attacks in France]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/aug/09/we-made-a-deal-ex-french-spy-chief-admits-1983-pact-with-fatah-terrorists (''The Guardian'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Deputy Prime Minister of Italy]] [[Matteo Salvini]] presents a [[vote of no-confidence]] against [[Prime Minister of Italy|Prime Minister]] [[Giuseppe Conte]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-italy-politics-confidence/italys-league-seeks-to-trigger-elections-files-censure-motion-idUSKCN1UZ0Z7?il=0 (Reuters)]
